scope: Round 3 narrow verification of SEC-T7-002 round-2 fix (commit 5b2839c) in frontend/stores/bot.ts connect() error-path redaction. Did not re-litigate skipped findings (SEC-T7-002 devtools-trace residual, SEC-T7-003 URL encoding).

verification.finding: SEC-T7-002 round-2 (Major) — typeof opts.body === 'object' guard was a no-op in production because ofetch JSON-stringifies the body before dispatch.
verification.fixCode: const opts = (err as { options?: { body?: unknown } })?.options; if (opts) opts.body = '[redacted]'

checks.check: Unconditional redaction handles JSON-string body (realistic ofetch production shape)
checks.evidence: tests/stores/bot.spec.ts:138-161 mocks options.body as JSON.stringify({token: TOKEN}); asserts errOpts?.body === '[redacted]' and JSON.stringify(caught) does not contain TOKEN_MARKER.

checks.check: Unconditional redaction handles original object body (defensive)
checks.evidence: tests/stores/bot.spec.ts:163-180 mocks options.body as {token: TOKEN}; asserts JSON.stringify(caught) does not contain TOKEN_MARKER.

checks.check: response.status preserved for downstream consumers (404 interceptor, useApiError)
checks.evidence: Fix mutates only opts.body; err.response.status sits on a separate property and is untouched. tests/stores/bot.spec.ts:160 explicitly asserts response.status === 400 after redaction.

checks.check: No new leak surface introduced by removing the type guard
checks.evidence: Redaction is broader, not narrower. err.message, err.stack, err.response, err.request (URL) are untouched. URL is verified token-free by AC17 test at lines 103-115. FetchError.data is server-side response, not client outbound body.
No typeof narrowing remains; any non-null/non-undefined opts has body overwritten with the string '[redacted]' regardless of original type.
